meta.title: Optical management
meta.description: ERP and dashboard for multi-store opticians.

palette.hint: Tip: type an order or phone number

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.newCount: {count, plural, =0 {none new} one {# new} other {# new}}

unauthorized.title: Access denied
unauthorized.body: Your role does not give access to this page. If you think this is a mistake, ask the optician to check your permissions.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page does not exist or has been moved.

auth.loginSubtitle: Access the management space of your stores.
auth.forgotSubtitle: Get a link to choose a new password.
auth.setPasswordSubtitle: Create the password of your OPTICOR account.
auth.heroTitle: Your optical stores, clear and under control.
auth.heroPoint1: An order entered in under a minute, as simple as the paper slip.
auth.heroPoint2: Glasses tracked from the workshop to pick-up, with a WhatsApp reminder.
auth.heroPoint3: Revenue, charges and stock of every store, in real time.
auth.forgotSent: If an account exists for {email}, we just sent it an email with a link to choose a new password.
auth.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least {min} characters.
auth.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
auth.setPasswordNoSession: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new link.

errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.accountDisabled: This account is disabled. Contact the optician.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.weakPassword: This password is too weak. Choose a longer one.
errors.samePassword: Choose a password different from the old one.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again or ask for a new link.
errors.emailExists: An account already exists with this email.
errors.alreadyActive: This account is already active: the invitation can no longer be resent.
errors.linkInvalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new link.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.selfChange: You cannot change your own role or deactivate your own account.
errors.lastSuperAdmin: At least one active super admin must remain.
errors.secretaryStoreInvalid: A secretary must belong to an active store (not the lab).
errors.noStock: Not enough stock in this store. Ask for a transfer.
errors.duplicateSlip: This slip number already exists in this store.
errors.phoneExists: A client already exists with this phone number.
errors.invalidPrescription: The prescription is invalid (check the axes and values).
errors.totalBelowItems: The total must be at least the price of the products.
errors.noPendingDiscount: This client has no approved discount.
errors.discountTooHigh: The discount cannot go below the frame and products price.
errors.discountAlreadyApplied: A client discount is already applied to this order.
errors.amountTooHigh: The amount is more than the balance due.
errors.invalidStatusChange: This status change is not possible.
errors.balanceDue: The balance must be paid before delivery.
errors.prefixLocked: The prefix can no longer change: orders already use it.
errors.orderStoreInvalid: An order must belong to an active store (not the lab).
errors.frameRule: An order has at most one frame, and none when the client brings their own.
errors.chargeReadOnly: This charge comes from a supplier payment: edit it from the purchase.
errors.configMissing: Incomplete configuration: check the settings (charge categories, locations).
errors.prefixTaken: This prefix is already used by another store.
errors.inUse: This item is in use: archive it instead of deleting it.

charges.description: Every expense of your stores, approved or pending.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Adapt the application to the way you work.

users.title: Users
users.description: One account per person. A secretary belongs to a single store.
users.sentBody: An email was sent to {email}. The link lets them choose a password.
users.deactivateBody: Access is blocked immediately and the person is signed out. History is kept; you can reactivate the account.

lists.title: Dropdown lists
lists.description: Each list feeds the app’s menus. Renaming an item updates it everywhere; an item in use is archived instead of deleted.
lists.usage: {count, plural, =0 {not used} one {used # time} other {used # times}}
lists.systemHint: Used by the app’s rules: it can be renamed or archived, not deleted.
lists.archiveBody: It will no longer appear in menus. Existing orders and charges keep it, so history stays accurate. You can restore it.
lists.deleteBody: This item is not used anywhere: it will be deleted permanently.
lists.fixedBody: Order statuses drive the tracking of each pair of glasses: they cannot be changed.

products.typesDescription: The three stocked product types. Lenses are not a product: they are never in stock.
products.categoriesDescription: Stock is tracked per category. A new price applies to new orders; past orders keep their price.
products.archiveBody: It will no longer appear in new orders or purchases. Stock and history stay visible. You can restore it.
products.thresholdsDescription: An alert is sent when the quantity goes down to this threshold or below. Empty cell: no alert.
